title: Trade desk: printed card names
description: Promissory notes, action cards and secret objectives in the trade desk show their printed names instead of engine ids (cf:generic, ra:jolnar, sabo1), in the staging summary, the Quick deals list and the answer screen. Before is the base commit, after is this branch. Synthetic fixtures with ids as the engine writes them.

shots.heading: Staging summary, before
shots.caption: A Ceasefire (cf:generic) staged for Jolnar's Research Agreement (ra:jolnar): the item tiles and the 'Ready to propose' sentence print the raw ids.

shots.heading: Staging summary, after
shots.caption: The same staging with printed names: 'Ceasefire' and 'Research Agreement (jolnar)' on the tiles and in the 'Ready to propose' sentence (the item tiles were already fixed by 66d8de0; the sentence was not). The raw id stays in the tooltip.

shots.heading: Quick deals, before
shots.caption: The engine's labels as written: 'sell cf:generic for 2 trade goods', 'pay 4 trade goods for the note ra:jolnar'.

shots.heading: Quick deals, after
shots.caption: Labels rebuilt from the decoded deal terms with printed names. An id no card table knows (mystery_pact:generic) becomes 'Mystery Pact' instead of a raw token; the engine label is in the tooltip.

shots.heading: Answer screen, before
shots.caption: The prompt 'Jolnar gives ra:jolnar, the action card sabo1 for 3 commodities, cf:generic -- accept?' shows ids in the header.

shots.heading: Answer screen, after
shots.caption: The prompt and the summary lines use printed names: Research Agreement (jolnar), Sabotage, Ceasefire.

notes.title: Web only.
notes.text: The engine labels and prompts are unchanged; the client rewrites ids it recognises from the decoded deal terms and falls back to the engine text when a label cannot be decoded.
